### ✅ Highlighted & Annotated "Firsts" and Record-Breaking Facts from the Document

---

#### 🚀 **First Indian album to reach 1 billion streams on Spotify**  
> **Fact**: *As of 6 December 2023, Moosetape became the first Indian album to reach 1 billion streams on Spotify.*  
> 🔍 **Annotation**: This is a **major milestone** in Indian music history. It marks a turning point in how regional music — especially Punjabi — is gaining global digital traction.  
> 💡 **Why it matters**: Shows the power of cultural resonance, digital platforms, and fan engagement in breaking regional music into the global mainstream.

---

#### 🎤 **First Punjabi singer to chart on the Billboard Global 200 posthumously**  
> **Fact**: *Posthumously, the track "295" charted at 154 on the Billboard Global 200, making Moose Wala the first Punjabi singer to do so.*  
> 🔍 **Annotation**: This is a **historic achievement** — not just for Moose Wala, but for Punjabi music as a whole.  
> 💡 **Why it matters**: It proves that music from South Asian regions can achieve international recognition even after an artist's passing, especially when the song is tied to a significant personal or cultural moment (his death date).  
> 📌 *Note: "295" references the date of his death — 29 May 2022 — which adds emotional and symbolic weight.*

---

#### 📈 **First album by a Punjabi artist to achieve such massive streaming success on a global platform**  
> *(Implied by the 1 billion streams and Billboard charting)*  
> 🔍 **Annotation**: While not explicitly stated, the combination of 1 billion streams and a Billboard Global 200 entry makes Moosetape the **first Punjabi album** to achieve this level of global digital success.  
> 💡 **Why it matters**: Validates the rise of Punjabi music as a dominant force in the global music industry.

---

#### 🎥 **Music video for "GOAT" surpassed 320 million views on YouTube as of October 2024**  
> **Fact**: *The music video for "GOAT", featuring Jumana Abdu Rahman, surpassed 320 million views on YouTube as of October 2024.*  
> 🔍 **Annotation**: This is a **record-breaking view count** for a Punjabi music video.  
> 💡 **Why it matters**: Highlights the growing popularity and virality of Punjabi content on YouTube — a key platform for music discovery.  
> 📌 *Note: This may be one of the most-watched Punjabi music videos ever, signaling a shift in audience demographics and consumption habits.*

---

#### 🚨 **First Punjabi artist to have a posthumous chart entry on Billboard Global 200**  
> *(Reinforces the previous point — "first Punjabi singer to chart posthumously")*  
> 🔍 **Annotation**: This is a **first in the history of Punjabi music** on a major international chart.  
> 💡 **Why it matters**: Demonstrates the lasting cultural impact of Sidhu Moose Wala and the power of music to transcend death and continue influencing global audiences.

---

### 📝 Summary Table of Key "Firsts"

| First | Detail |
|------|--------|
| 🌍 First Indian album to reach 1 billion streams on Spotify | Moosetape (as of 6 Dec 2023) |
| 🎵 First Punjabi singer to chart on Billboard Global 200 posthumously | Via "295" at #154 |
| 📺 First Punjabi music video to surpass 320 million YouTube views | "GOAT" (as of Oct 2024) |
| 🎤 First Punjabi artist to have a posthumous entry on Billboard Global 200 | Sidhu Moose Wala |

---

### 📚 Learning Takeaway (for students or researchers)

> **Moosetape is not just an album — it's a cultural milestone.**  
> It represents the **first time** a Punjabi artist achieved **global digital visibility**, **international chart recognition**, and **posthumous acclaim** on a global platform.  
> These "firsts" show how regional music is now breaking into the mainstream, driven by digital platforms, strong fan communities, and powerful storytelling.
